method: CUA native Safari app clicks and macOS keyboard shortcuts; AX text plus visible selection inspection. No page JavaScript event dispatch, injected clipboard contents or direct system clipboard reads.
observations: Keyboard-selected first bullet copied to the scratch textarea with exact text and no bullet marker.
Cut of the same range emptied only that bullet. Pasting into scratch retained its exact text. One toolbar Undo restored the text and visible selection.
Typing ! at the end of the first numbered item inserted one character. Cmd+Z removed it; Cmd+Shift+Z restored it.
Cmd+V then inserted the bullet text exactly once after ! without importing a bullet. One Cmd+Z removed only the paste; a second removed !.
Forward selection across both numbered items copied exact text separated by one newline, without ordinal markers.

Backward selection across both numbered items cut to one empty item starting at 3. The scratch textarea received exact newline-separated text. One Undo restored both items numbered 3 and 4 and the selected text.
Cmd+Shift+Z reapplied the cross-item cut; Cmd+Z restored both items. Copy of the restored range again produced exact newline-separated text.

initialSelectionAttempt.result: Not a valid clipboard pass or confirmed product failure.
initialSelectionAttempt.observation: CUA selectText on the editor left a caret at the end of the second bullet, not the requested selected first bullet. The initial trusted Copy was followed by an empty scratch paste. A second selection attempt was inspected visually and likewise had no highlighted range.
initialSelectionAttempt.correction: Click inside the intended line, use Cmd+Left followed by Cmd+Shift+Right, and verify the highlighted text before Copy. Native copy then passed without product changes.
initialSelectionAttempt.limit: The cause of the accessibility selection action failing to establish a range was not diagnosed. A trusted event alone does not prove a valid selection or clipboard output.

capturedReport.qualification: Not automatic certification. Trusted events can also originate from browser automation; checklist observations are self-reported.
